title: Unpaid Meal Charge Repayment Plan: Terms for Inactive School Nutrition Services Meal Accounts
content:
A household that owes unpaid meal charges on an inactive meal account repays them under the district's unpaid meal charge repayment plan, and each repayment payment is the parent's own act: the parent pays it personally through the district's online payment portal, because district staff never take card numbers; School Nutrition quotes the payment due on the day of the quote, and no fee, interest or penalty is ever added.

These terms govern the inactive School Nutrition Services Meal Account of a student who has left the district. Each repayment payment posts on the inactive account itself, as an online card deposit dated the day it is paid.

## The payment: `pay_inactive_meal_installment_c0dba3e7`

**Capability.** The parent or guardian makes a repayment-plan payment, personally, by card through the district's online payment portal, toward the unpaid meal charges on an inactive cafeteria meal account of a student who has left the district. One call posts one payment to that account: the amount is credited to the account balance and reduces the unpaid meal charges by the same amount, the payment is recorded as an online card deposit dated today, and the portal issues a confirmation number. No fee, interest or penalty is added, and the processor's convenience fee is never posted.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `pay_inactive_meal_installment_c0dba3e7` (through `unlock_user_discoverable_tool`) and hands it over; the customer themselves then runs it (through `call_user_discoverable_tool`), paying personally by card through the portal.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `meal_account_id` | the meal account reference number of the departed student whose unpaid meal charges are being repaid | identifier, exactly as the meal account lookup for the household returns it |
| `amount` | the repayment payment credited to the account | US dollars, a positive number with 2 decimal places (cents), already rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence carrying four fields: the payment record reference (text identifier of the new account transaction), the meal account reference credited, the amount credited in US dollars with two decimals, and the portal confirmation number (eight digits beginning with 72). The presence of the confirmation number means the payment posted. A message beginning with "Error:" means nothing was posted: "Error: amount must be a positive dollar amount with at most two decimal places." for an amount that is not positive or has more than two decimals, and an error naming the reference when no meal account carries it.
